selection_basis: Candidate inclusion records factual medium and inventory provenance; it does not encode ideology, party, audience, quality, or network membership.
Route verification, distinct-editorial-product review, family assignment, reliability, and marginal coverage value are required before shadow registration.
The reservoir deliberately includes national, specialist, state, local, newsletter, podcast, and creator-led products so the initial panel is not merely a list of high-traffic national websites.
